_note: Next Top Comic (DESIGN.md): stand-up mini-game using the dialogue system in Monkey Island insult-sword-fighting structure (Sarah Silverman). Just horrible unfunny setup / punchline pairings, but the women in the audience think it's hilarious. 'setups' is the set, in order: each is {"setup": text, "punchlines": [text, ...]}; the player picks a punchline. Silverman speaks every setup, so each setup is a quote from data/quotes/silverman.json, verbatim, and only quotes marked verified=true there (tests/test_quotes_vv.gd); the punchlines are the player's. When the setups run out the set ends and comic_done is written.
title: Next Top Comic

setups.setup: Can I just say to the 'Bernie or bust' people, you're being ridiculous.
punchlines: Bernie or bust? More like Bernie or bus. Because of public transit.
Ridiculous is my middle name. My first name is also Ridiculous. My parents were not creative.
What do you call a bust that votes? A ballot. No. I had this one written down.
I am a bust person myself. Busts of presidents. I have nine. They watch me sleep.

setups.setup: I will vote for Hillary with gusto
punchlines: I tried to vote with gusto, but they only take photo ID.
Gusto is my cat. He is registered. I am told that is a problem.

setups.setup: I'm proud to be a part of Bernie's movement
punchlines: My doctor said I need more movement. So I joined one.
I'm part of a movement too. It mostly moves toward the buffet.
I was part of a movement once. Then the music stopped and I didn't get a chair.
Neither was my marriage. You could tell.
That's what I tell the man at the parking garage.
Neither is this punchline. It is on a card, but the card is improvising.
